entries.signal: control.valueChanged if isinstance(control, QDoubleSpinBox) else control.currentIndexChanged

entries.slot: lambda enabled: self.synchronize(self.views[0].shared_center, self.views[0].shared_zoom) if enabled and self.views else None
lambda item, old: self.select_slot(item.data(Qt.UserRole)) if item else None
lambda center, zoom, v=view: self.navigate(v, center, zoom)
lambda a, r, b: self.attempt(lambda: self.set_relation(a, r, b, background=True))
lambda row: self.say(f"已保存 {row['done']} / {row['total']} 個工作項目")
lambda row: self.say('已完成候選學習；請檢視後採用預覽規則。' if row['phase'] == 'COMPLETE' else '已暫停；可從保存位置接續。')
lambda value: self.solve_status.setText(f"正在比較可用版面：{value['done'] + 1}／{value['total']}。資料仍保留，可停止。")
lambda checked: [self.load(pane) for pane in self.panes]

entries.signal: widget.textChanged if widget is self.text else widget.valueChanged

entries.slot: lambda item, previous: self.candidate_list.setCurrentRow(item.data(Qt.UserRole)) if item else None
lambda row: self.say('已保存 ' + str(row['done']) + '／' + str(row['total']) + ' 個驗證案例。')
lambda row: self.say('驗證結果已保存，可接著核對適合範圍或正式資格。' if row['phase'] == 'COMPLETE' else '已暫停，已完成的案例仍在本機。')
lambda value, key=attribute: (setattr(canvas, key, value), canvas.viewport().update())
lambda *_: self.cancel.set() if self.running else None
lambda index: self.closure_panel.activate() if self.tabs.widget(index) is self.closure_panel else None
lambda index: self.quality_panel.activate() if self.tabs.widget(index) is self.quality_scroll else None
lambda _, identity=row['id'], owner=person, widget=combo: self.bind(identity, owner, widget)
lambda checked=False, x=dx, y=dy: (dialog.accept(), canvas.request_nudge(x, y))
